items.title: A growth mechanism for grain-boundary-free ultraflat silver thin films
items.summary: STEM revealed a feasible mechanism for a breakthrough in metal thin-film epitaxy, enabling wafer-scale growth of atomically flat, grain-boundary-free Ag films on Cu buffers with a 13% lattice mismatch.

media.alt: Atomically flat single-crystal silver thin film imaged by STEM

items.title: A machine learning solution for electrode characterization
items.summary: Machine learning-driven electron spectroscopic imaging (ESI) enables nanoscale visualization and statistical analysis of structural degradation in PEMFC electrodes.
